lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately eight longitudinal rows of high-luminance, circular blobs are visible across the dorsal and lateral surfaces, maintaining a semi-regular grid spacing along the anterior-posterior axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the longitudinal rows of blobs, forming a discernible grid-like pattern particularly visible on the upper mid-section of the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary longitudinal ridges (carinae) are visible; a central dorsal ridge and parallel lateral ridges exhibit a distinct high-intensity highlight along the crest with a sharp transition to shadow on the ventral-facing slopes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, cylindrical orange and yellow telemetry tag is attached to the dermis near the anterior base of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A large, white, multi-winged electronic monitoring device is tethered to the dorsal region by a thin line, floating above the shark's body.
